Using the scalar projection formula:
\[
\frac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{a}|}
\]
Compute \(\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}\):
\[
|\vec{a}+\vec{b}|^2 - |\vec{a}-\vec{b}|^2 = 4\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}
\]
\[
4^2 - 6^2 = 16 - 36 = -20 = 4\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}
\]
\[
\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b} = -5
\]
Thus:
\[
\frac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{a}|} = \frac{-5}{5} = -1
\]

\boxed{-1}
